findings.evidence: On both desktop surfaces the entire content area is a fixed-height, horizontally panning timeline whose earlier columns (steps 01-04 on ENTRY; years before 2020 on DISCOVERY) sit offscreen with no scrollbar, arrows or cue, and the header carries only a page label with no conventional nav or link pattern. Mobile falls back to a familiar vertical list, but the desktop default is the novel pattern rather than a limited use of it.

findings.evidence: No ADRs, ledger, docs/ or plan files exist in the worktree. STRATEGY.md and README.md state the framework/plugin's purpose (a paragraph, not the page's job); docs/frames/ holds only a README (no frame was written for the site); the page was 'extracted verbatim' from another repo (commit 18ffcf2) and later 'updated ... findings.evidence: No document records stack/time/team/design-system constraints for the site before it was built. docs/frames and docs/plans contain only READMEs. NOTICE and package.json describe the stack after the fact.
findings.expected_value: Tempo, stack, time e sistema de design considerados antes de desenhar — não descobertos no meio.
